articles.title: How the Cowboys are wasting late-round draft picks
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys have demonstrated a mixed performance in the initial four rounds of the NFL draft since 2010. While showing overall fairness in these early selections, the team has notably struggled in the second round. An analysis covering 2010-2025 indicates that 48 players drafted in these rounds have contributed significantly, reflecting ongoing efforts to build a competitive roster.

articles.title: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya to develop centre for precision manufacturing: Vaishnaw
articles.summary: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya (GSV) is tasked with developing a Centre of Excellence for precision manufacturing, Union Railways Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced. This initiative aims to bolster India's advanced manufacturing capabilities, supporting the transport sector and wider industrial growth. It represents a strategic step to integrate education with national infrastructure and technological development, fostering skilled talent and innovation.

articles.title: Australia, India, Japan, New Zealand, U.S. complete exercise Sea Dragon 2026
articles.summary: Exercise Sea Dragon 2026 successfully concluded at Andersen Air Force Base, Guam, on March 28, 2026. This multinational anti-submarine warfare (ASW) exercise, led by the U.S. 7th Fleet, focused on enhancing interoperability and maritime security in the Indo-Pacific region. Such joint drills are vital for strengthening defence capabilities and regional stability among participating nations.

articles.title: The eyes, ears and nose of a young traveller exploring Kochi, India, for the first time
articles.summary: An individual completed a seventeen-hour journey, arriving in Kochi at 11 PM. The city experienced warm, humid conditions, with temperatures in the mid-20s Celsius and approximately 70% humidity. This personal account of arriving in a prominent Indian city emphasizes geographical awareness and environmental observation, vital for SSB aspirants to understand diverse national settings and potential subsequent events.

articles.title: Trump issues new warning to Iran over Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump warned Iran Washington would destroy its energy plants and oil wells if Tehran failed to open the Strait of Hormuz. This stern warning follows Iran's rejection of US peace proposals, escalating tensions over the critical global shipping route vital for oil transit, highlighting significant international strategic concerns.
